overall: The AG found the Council did not violate the OML: the mayor-created committee fell within the Connelly exception as an informal advisory body to a single official, so it was not a public body required to post notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a mayor-created Special Ad Hoc Committee failed to comply with the OML's notice posting requirements for its meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee was created by a public official to advise him on a decision that he retained the sole authority to make, we find that this Committee fell within the Connelly exception
